name: homoglyph-guard
title: Homoglyph Guard
description: Username and domain field that detects look-alike, mixed-script, styled (math bold, fullwidth) and zero-width characters following UTS #39 ideas, names each character's script and code point, flags imitations of protected names, and offers the plain-ASCII version in one tap.

meta.stops: Helps catch a spoofed username with Cyrillic letters
meta.summary: Flags look-alike, mixed-script, styled and invisible characters in usernames and domains, such as pаypal.com with a Cyrillic а.
meta.server: Normalise and run confusable checks on the server at registration and before display; client-side checks are easy to bypass.
catches: Cyrillic, Greek and other cross-script look-alikes mixed into Latin text
Styled Unicode letters that fold to ASCII (fullwidth, mathematical)
Imitations of names you protect, such as paypa1 or rnicrosoft
limits: Uses a curated look-alike table, not the full Unicode confusables.txt; rarer confusables are missed
Legitimate non-Latin names can be flagged as mixed-script
Advisory only; it does not reserve or block names
a11y: Visible label tied to the input, described by the report
Report is a polite live region; flagged characters are <mark> elements with their Unicode name as title
Fix button's aria-label includes the ASCII value it will set
